title: ci-runner status --json
description: What `ci-runner.sh status --json` prints: the gate, the file it reports every tick, and each registered repository's switch. The contract the panel reads; schema 1. A field is added, never changed in meaning, without raising `schema`.

gate.description: The gate container as docker reports it, plus what can be told about its credential without reading it.

state.description: The container's State.Status (running, exited, ...), or absent when there is no gate.

locked.description: True when the gate holds no credential (a fresh start or a reboot) and serves nothing until unlocked. Null unless the gate is running.

paused.description: True while the pause flag is set: running jobs finish, nothing new starts. Null unless the gate is running.

commit.description: The commit the running gate image was built from (short sha, `-dirty` when gate/ had uncommitted changes), from its GATE_COMMIT environment. Null when absent or the image predates it.

token_expires.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the gate's main token, from the file beside it. Null when locked or when none was recorded. The token itself is never read.

owner_tokens.description: The owners (organisations) the gate holds a token of their own for. Empty when there are none or the gate is not running.

owner.description: The owner's login, lower-cased as the gate stores it.

expires.description: That token's expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when none was recorded.

status.description: The file the gate rewrites every tick at /run/gate/status.json, passed through as it is; its `ts` says how fresh it is. Null when the gate is not running or the file is unreadable.

ts.description: When the gate wrote the file (UTC, ISO 8601). Written at the top of the tick, so it is the last heartbeat.

locked.description: True when the gate has no credential. Counts and queue then describe the last pass, not new work.

paused.description: True while the pause flag is set.

repos.description: The repositories the gate is told to serve (owner/repo).

queue.description: Jobs GitHub had queued for this machine's labels at the last pass, in the order they are admitted.

repo.description: The repository the job is queued in.

class.description: The runner class the job asked for: now, big, little or mega.

since.description: When GitHub queued or started the job (ISO 8601).

branch.description: The head branch of the workflow run.

non_local_queued.description: Count of queued workflow runs with non-local jobs (such as dependabot or ubuntu-latest), excluding 0-job ghost runs.

rate_limit.description: Last observed GitHub REST API rate-limit state.

remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current window.

reset_at.description: When the rate-limit window resets (UTC, ISO 8601), or null.

throttled.description: True when the gate is throttling or pausing due to low remaining quota.

busy.description: Runners GitHub reports busy in the served repositories at the last pass.

used.description: Cores of the budget in use: the cost of every runner container the gate owns.

budget.description: The budget in cores in force, live override or boot flag.

big_used.description: Cores held by big and now runners, counted against big_cap.

big_cap.description: The most of the budget big runners may hold together.

class_costs.description: What one runner of each class costs against the budget, in cores.

big.description: Cost of a big (and now) runner.

mega.description: Cost of a mega runner: the whole current budget (read live, so it follows a budget change), or the big cost when the gate does not serve mega.

memory_available_mb.description: MemAvailable of the machine the gate runs on, in MiB. Null when it could not be read.

memory_floor_mb.description: The memory below which no job is started, in MiB.

load.description: The one-minute load average. Null when it could not be read.

load_ceiling.description: The load above which no job is started.

draining.description: The mega job the gate is holding the line for (nothing queued behind it starts until the machine is empty), or null when no mega job is held.

ref.description: The run id and job id, as run/job.

since.description: When the gate first held the line for it (ISO 8601).

seconds.description: How long it has been held.

overdue.description: True once the hold is past MEGA_DRAIN_WARN. Nothing is forced.

waiting.description: Why a queued job did not start at the last pass, in words (memory, load or budget), or null when nothing waited.

commit.description: The commit the gate was built from.

repositories.description: Every repository in the registry (the ci-local topic) and whether its CI runs here.

ci_runner.description: The repository's CI_RUNNER variable: 1 runs CI on this machine, 0 on GitHub. Null when unset or unreadable. Read from GitHub and kept for 60 seconds.

mega.description: The repository's CI_RUNNER_LABEL_MEGA variable: the label its mega job runs on (the switch is on), or null when unset (the job runs as an ordinary big). Read from GitHub and kept for 60 seconds.
